capabilities: Display yearly heatmaps of daily and weekly note activity
Browse a monthly calendar and open or create notes by date
Track Markdown sections across journal entries with yearly counts
Initialize settings from Daily Notes, Calendar, or Periodic Notes
extras: The current interface and default section names are in Chinese; section names and aliases can be customized for any Markdown journal. Installed manually by copying files into .obsidian/plugins/.
problem: Obsidian offers no visual year-level overview of when journal entries were written or which tracked sections they contain.

relations.evidence: The calendar and week navigation were inspired by Calendar for Obsidian.
can initialize its settings from Obsidian's Daily Notes, Calendar, or enabled Periodic Notes settings

summary: Journal review plugin that shows GitHub-style yearly heatmaps, a monthly calendar, and per-section tracking for daily and weekly notes.
